## Load libraries and establish settings

**Task** Create a codeblock and load appropriate packages and settings for this lab.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(rvest)
install.packages(readxl)
library(readxl)
```

## Load the GHG dataset

```{r}
ghg_data <- read_xls("data/flight.xls") |> clean_names()
```

## Group by parent companies

```{r}
parent_comp <- ghg_data |>
  group_by(parent_companies) |>
  summarise(count=n()) |>
  arrange(desc(count))
```
